definitions.gloss: how one looks in photographs; photogenicity
definitions.explanation: The way a person (or thing) comes out in photos, compared with how they really look.

examples.japanese: {写真写|しゃしんうつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{写真写|しゃしんうつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: I never look good in photos.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証明|しょうめい}{写真|しゃしん}→証明写真：32626_shoumeishashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{写真写|しゃしんうつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{撮|と}り{直|なお}した→撮り直す：25509_torinaosu⟧。
examples.english: I worried about how I looked in my ID photo and retook it many times.

notes:
Almost always with ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: {写真写|しゃしんうつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (photogenic), {写真写|しゃしんうつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (not photogenic). {写真映|しゃしんうつ}り is also seen.
